MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Replace drinking water

3. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.

4. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the volume

5. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   D. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   C. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.

7. Best practice when working on Elements of Music RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   B. Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   D. Damage equipment used for Elements of Music RESPONDING.

8. Best practice when working on Singing Games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Singing Games.
   C. Damage equipment used for Singing Games.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Singing Games.

9. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   B. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   C. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Dance.

10. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Green, orange, and purple

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of Music RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Singing Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of Music RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
